title: SPEAR：基于代码增强的智能体提示优化
summary: SPEAR将代码即行动范式引入自动提示工程，提出沙盒式主动回滚优化器。它通过Python沙盒执行结构化错误分析，并采用自动回滚和指标下限两个护栏确保单调改进。在工业级LLM评判任务和BBH/GSM8K基准上全面超越现有方法。
summary_en: SPEAR ports the code-as-action paradigm to automatic prompt engineering, introducing a sandboxed agentic optimizer with Python execution for structural error analysis and monotonic improvement guardrails. It outperforms existing methods on industrial LLM-as-judge tasks and BBH/GSM8K benchmarks.
